evidence_states.assumption: a value chosen for this screen, stated beside the figures it sets; no source was retrieved this round
evidence_states.general_knowledge: a published specification or widely given value stated from general knowledge; the document was not retrieved this round

evidence_states.source_summary: taken from a source's abstract or summary as retrieved, the full text not read
